actionable.observation: 一个训练好的adapter迁移不同base策略，联合base likelihood与energy的消融解释残差作用。
actionable.editorial_advice: 原创示例：CREBM reranks routes proposed by an existing planner using a preference-trained residual energy. With Neuralsym and Retro*-0, top-1 exact-match accuracy rises from 42.0% to 44.5%; the energy-only ablation drops to 34.1%, supporting the use of both scores.

counterexamples.finding: Implemented criterion is heuristic forward-model/product plus starting-material-reference Tanimoto; no chemist-preference study, wet-lab synthesis, costs/yields or environmental evaluation. Reranks sampled proposals, cannot generate an absent feasible route. Table1 gains cover tested adapters;Retrosim/G2Gs/Megan lack CREBM rows. General composition proposal exceeds tested single feasibility-proxy criterion; keep that distinction without negating measured gains.

42.0→44.5 is2.5percentage points not2.5%relative. DepthTable2 only2–6, not arbitrary long routes; no reported run variance or significance, speed/training-cost comparison. Q&A RL failure lacks numerical protocol/results; cannot establish BT generally superior or infeasible NCE. Avoid copying rhetorical certainty as evidence standard.

Eq7 equates reactant-set probability to a chosen-reactant marginal along a branch; clarify full branching route distribution. Eq11 normalization notation and Algorithm1 argmax rawE need reconciliation with preference loss. Main says reused baseline metrics vs appendix all baselines conducted locally. These are author clarification items, not venue conventions.

AppendixE explicitly ChatGPT-generated acetic-acid illustration, not a measured chemistry comparison or independently verified industrial/environmental evidence. Do not promote it into empirical dataset or factual writing rule.
